Source-bound parent `1951ea17085c97bbf744ec897a06239abecb0f21`; candidate `7a0c47039f6b7d57ad4cd53664092a5a955b52ce`.

Five focused synthetic actual-module regression groups cover negative/positive and history immutability.

Frozen 603 reference is SKIPPED/not application proof. Do not deploy or write production/provider data. Coordinates with #267/#33/#96, separate ownership.
